objective: Discover short-term opportunistic long chromosomes that harvest temporary rallies while the independent market regime remains DEFENSIVE.
governing_assumption: The bear market is expected to continue. Defensive trades are temporary opportunities, not declarations of recovery.
state_invariants: GA cannot declare recovery, R-1, NORMAL, or modify A/B/C.
Profitability of a defensive-origin trade cannot change market state.
All trades are short-duration by design.
Renewed deterioration should trigger exit/profit-taking rather than tolerance of prolonged adverse continuation.

laboratory.stock_data: Consumed DEV50 trajectories only; only names present in reconstructed cache are eligible.

available_causal_evidence_families: stock path returns and adverse excursion observed only through decision time
recent high/low structure and failed rebound behavior
lagged OFR funding/credit context where causally available
chromosome_permission: choose any nonempty subset of admitted causal evidence
choose bounded thresholds from causal rolling distributions or bounded normalized levels
choose entry delay within short-term bound
choose exit evidence based on renewed deterioration/opposite-of-recovery direction
choose maximum holding period within short-term bound
choose whether to take profit immediately or continue while rebound evidence persists
choose whether to re-enter later while DEFENSIVE

short_term_bounds.rationale: Low-hanging-fruit objective; not designed to hold through renewed bear continuation.

fitness_principles: Reward net realized return after realistic costs.
Reward positive expectancy across multiple declining-market episodes.
Reward profit factor and win rate only as secondary metrics.
Penalize giveback from maximum favorable excursion to exit.
Penalize remaining in a trade while renewed deterioration evidence strengthens.
Penalize long holding periods absent incremental reward.
Penalize episode concentration and poor worst-window expectancy.
Retain trade count and minimum per-window participation gates.
Do not reward catching full rally peaks or using future trough/recovery information.
anti_overfit: No fixed hand-authored profit target as a required exit.
No fixed hand-authored stop as a required exit.
No known trough or R-1 date as a feature.
comparison_note: Previously completed Phase-2/2B constrained GA remains preserved as a separate side experiment and is not the governing Defensive GA search.
scientific_role: GA is the search engine. Human guidance defines causality, short-term intent, evidence boundaries, and bear-continuation risk asymmetry only.
